activeQuestion.prompt: How did the schools’ letters support the award?
activeQuestion.promptZh: 學校的來信為何有助於公司得獎？

options.text: They documented strong sales of electronics in the region.
options.zh: 它們證明電子產品在當地賣得好。
options.whyZh: 頒獎不看銷售，信件也不是在報告銷售。

options.text: They asked the council to give each school a seat.
options.zh: 它們請協會給每所學校一個席位。
options.whyZh: 來信內容是活動效果，未談座位。

options.text: They proposed selling repair services to new schools.
options.zh: 它們建議向更多學校銷售維修服務。
options.whyZh: 提到的是學校受益於既有的志工活動，不是拓展營收。

options.text: They showed how the volunteer work helped students learn.
options.zh: 它們說明志工工作如何幫助學生學習。
options.whyZh: 學生透過實作理解電子學，與社區合作獎的宗旨一致。

group.title: An award announcement
group.passage: F1: Our company won the council's community partnership award. It honors our technicians' volunteer repair sessions at schools, not our sales. Schools wrote to the council about how hands-on activities helped students understand electronics. The ceremony is at the civic center on June twelfth. We have six seats. Employees who joined a school visit get priority. Contact me by Friday if you want a seat. Next month we'll display photos from the program in reception.
group.passageZh: 本公司獲得協會的社區合作獎。獎項表揚的是公司技師在學校辦的志工維修活動，而不是銷售表現。學校寫信給協會，說明動手實作如何幫助學生理解電子學。頒獎典禮在六月十二日於市民中心舉行，公司有六個席位。參與過校訪的員工優先。如需席位，請在週五前聯絡我。下個月會在接待區展示計畫照片。
